en-US.name: SAG Wiki Skill
en-US.summary: Optional local MIT package of the SAG CLI skill for setup, semantic search, indexed folders, ignore rules and MCP configuration. Requires the separately licensed @zleap-ai/sag CLI; this package is only the skill files plus the upstream root LICENSE, not the full SAG Wiki app.
en-US.description: Independently maintained market packaging of Zleap-AI/SAG-Wiki@b6940ac834b3b1ec651c0b49dc1b0c45d4d74c4a path cli/skills/sag. The real DesireCore installer copies only the skill content directory and does not pull a parent LICENSE, so this package places the upstream MIT LICENSE in the installed tree. Package version 2026.11.24.

zh-CN.name: SAG Wiki 技能
zh-CN.summary: SAG CLI 技能的可选 MIT 本地包，用于安装配置、语义检索、索引目录、忽略规则和 MCP。需另行安装并运行独立许可的 @zleap-ai/sag CLI；本包只含技能文件和上游根 LICENSE，不含完整 SAG Wiki 应用。
zh-CN.description: 基于 Zleap-AI/SAG-Wiki@b6940ac834b3b1ec651c0b49dc1b0c45d4d74c4a 路径 cli/skills/sag 的市场本地包装。真实 DesireCore 安装器只复制技能内容目录，不会自动带上父目录 LICENSE，因此本包把上游 MIT LICENSE 放进安装产物。包版本 2026.11.24。

requirements.value: A DesireCore-compatible client that can install this optional local skill from the market catalog.
The separately licensed @zleap-ai/sag CLI must be installed and configured by the operator; this package does not vendor the CLI or the full SAG Wiki application.
